subject: Re: Kickoff: Latent Programmer for example-driven pipeline synthesis
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

Staffing: Efe 40% as modeling lead through April (his May is heavily committed elsewhere, so I've front-loaded his portion), Ondrej 50% on the internal-DSL dataset build — TFRecord generation matching the release's dataset_filepattern conventions — and Farah 30% on training infra and eval plumbing.

Compute for this window: 16 Titan A100s best-effort covers both the baseline and latent runs at the released step counts. No reservations needed.

On the Q3 question you flagged: I've pre-socialized the scale-up scenario with finance. Idris has verbally earmarked $120k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-81 for this project's scale-up runs. Cc'ing him for the record — Idris, we'll convert that to a formal request once the May 20 readout lands, but please treat B-81 as spoken for at that amount in your planning.

Bruno
